items.title: SWE-Duel:迈向编码代理人自我升级的竞技场
items.description: 静态编码基准被固定在发布时。 随着时间的推移,它们的任务会泄露到培训数据中,而更强大的代理人最终会饱和它们。 我们主张,一个基准应该着眼于自我扩展:它的任务和甲骨文是在评估时创建的。
items.titleOriginal: SWE-Duel: Towards a Self-Scaling Arena for Coding Agents
items.descriptionOriginal: arXiv:2610.12569v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Static coding benchmarks are fixed at release. Over time their tasks leak into training data, and stronger agents eventually saturate them. We argue that a benchmark should instead aim to be self-scaling: its tasks and oracles are created at evaluation
